description_en: Creates an access point for a CPFS for Lingjun file system
description_zh: 创建 CPFS 智算版 AccessPoint
kebab_example: aliyun nas create-cpfs-access-point --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --file-system-id bmcpfs-099394bd928c0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCpfsAccessPoint

parameters.help_en:
The file system ID.

CPFS: The ID must start with `cpfs-`, such as cpfs-125487\\.

CPFS for Lingjun: The ID must start with `bmcpfs-`, such as bmcpfs-0015\\
parameters.help_zh:
文件系统ID。

CPFS：必须以`cpfs-`开头，例如cpfs-125487\\。

CPFS智算版：必须以`bmcpfs-`开头，例如bmcpfs-0015\\
parameters.name: file_system_id

parameters.help_en:
The description of the access point.

Limits:
The description must be 2 to 128 characters in length.
The description must start with a letter.It cannot start with http:// or https://.
The description can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), or hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
接入点描述。

限制：
长度为 2~128 个英文或中文字符。
必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以http://和https://开头。
可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: description

fields.help_en: The root directory of the access point. The value must start and end with a forward slash (/)
fields.help_zh: 接入点根目录。必须以/开头和结尾
fields.name: root_path

parameters.help_en: The root directory of the access point. Default value: "/"
parameters.help_zh: 接入点根目录。 默认值为“/”
parameters.name: root_directory
